findings.one_line: The proposed theorem-level contribution—a coefficient-complete, relatively open strict-containment certificate with a rational witness and equality locus—has been replaced by an expressly unresolved obligation; the proved compactness, face identity, static reduction, CAD specialization, and fiber-inversion coverage do not supply that advertised dynamic novelty.

This usable coverage statement is a direct image-of-a-valid-fiber construction, but its positioning does not make a theorem-level comparison to the cited identified-set-inference literature; state precisely the additional inferential object or scope it advances, or present it explicitly as a supporting consequence rather than a standalone contribution.
